name: Chen Zhuo
current_role: Chairman-designate (previously President/CEO) of Avatr Technology; Vice President of Changan Automobile
profile: Chongqing-born Changan Automobile veteran (joined 2006) who ran brand PR and was company spokesperson before moving to Changan/Huawei/CATL-backed EV maker Avatr in Feb 2023, becoming president that December. Named a Changan VP in June 2026; Sept 2026 reports say he is moving up to Avatr chairman as it pursues a Hong Kong IPO.
interesting_fact: Under his leadership Avatr launched the 11, 12, 07 and 06 models plus the 06T and 07L, and refiled for a Hong Kong IPO in June 2026.
deep_cut_fact: He joined Changan straight out of an engineering degree in 2006 and rose through brand PR to become Changan's company spokesperson, and was CEO of its Qiyuan product line before leading Avatr.
notes: Corporate executive of state-owned Changan's EV subsidiary rather than a classic founder-owner; Hurun lists him as founder. Title in flux (president -> chairman reported Sept 2026, based on unnamed sources). Avatr site also lists oversea@avatr.com for overseas inquiries.

name: Yuan Dawei
current_role: Early backer/incubator of RedotPay (per single report); described as Huobi early co-founder and founder of Kusong Wallet
profile: Hurun lists him as a RedotPay founder. The only source found says RedotPay was initially incubated with investment from Yuan Dawei, an early Bitcoin enthusiast (since 2010), described as one of Huobi's early co-founders and founder of Kusong Wallet, with influence in early Bitcoin investor and mining circles. RedotPay's publicly named co-founders are Michael Gao (CEO) and Jonathan Chan.
interesting_fact: Reportedly began studying Bitcoin as early as 2010 and is described as an early Huobi co-founder (single, insider-sourced report; unverified).
notes: Very low public profile; role at RedotPay confirmed only by one KuCoin news flash citing insiders. Not named on RedotPay's own materials. Contacts are company-level only. Treat with caution.

name: Matthew Harpe
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Basis (AI agents for accounting firms), New York
profile: Former Boston Consulting Group consultant (healthcare and data science work) who co-founded Basis in 2023 with long-time friend Mitchell Troyanovsky after seeing accounting as a major bottleneck. Basis builds autonomous agents for accounting, tax and audit; it raised a $100M Series B at a $1.15B valuation in Feb 2026 and is used by a large share of the top 25 US firms.
interesting_fact: Neither founder is an accountant; Harpe got the idea for Basis while doing healthcare work at BCG, where he learned accounting was a major bottleneck.
deep_cut_fact: Basis names the conference rooms in its New York office after accounting and finance pioneers such as Luca Pacioli and Alexander Hamilton, and launched an 'Ode to Accounting' site collecting love letters to the profession.

public_contacts.value: Upstarts Media podcast interview with Matt Harpe

notes: Press contact in Basis's 2023 launch release is co-founder Mitchell Troyanovsky's address. Harpe gives interviews to trade press (Accounting Today, Upstarts) — likely receptive to podcast.

name: Sahir Jaggi
current_role: Founder and CEO, Forus (formerly Tandem), AI network for prescription access / prior authorization, New York
profile: Columbia graduate who spent ~5-6 years at Oscar Health (from 2017) on patient/consumer experience and product strategy, then founded Tandem in 2023, rebranded Forus in 2026. Forus automates the paperwork between a prescription and a patient's first dose; it hit a $1B valuation in May 2026 and $3B with a $150M Series C (Bain Capital Ventures) in Sept 2026.
interesting_fact: Forus tripled its valuation from $1B to $3B in about four months in 2026; Jaggi says nine of the top 15 global biopharma companies use Forus data on where patients drop off.
deep_cut_fact: He has said his years at Oscar Health left him 'radicalized by how challenging things are for patients and providers today,' and he started Forus with many of Oscar's same investors and some of the same team.
notes: Healthcare AI, not fintech as Hurun industry tag suggests. No published press email found; company social channels are best route. Does interviews (AlleyWatch, Becker's).
